question:
In a Young’s double-slit experiment, the slit separation is $d=0.50\,\text{mm}$ and the screen is at a distance $D=2.0\,\text{m}$. Monochromatic light of wavelength $\lambda=500\,\text{nm}$ is used.

A transparent sheet of thickness $t=4.0\,\mu\text{m}$ and refractive index $\mu=1.60$ is introduced in front of slit $S_1$ only, covering the beam completely.

Take $y$ as the transverse coordinate on the screen measured from $O$, where $O$ is the central bright position when no sheet is used. Positive $y$ is towards $S_1$.

Find 

(i) the shift $y_0$ of the central bright fringe (order $m=0$) relative to $O$, 

(ii) the number $N$ of fringes by which the entire pattern is shifted.
